## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Bryan, United States. It starts at 4324 West Highway 79.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> There's more than 500 exotic animals at Franklin Drive Thru Safari and many of the animals are just as happy to see you, as you are to see them.
>
> The safari is always adopting more exciting animals to their petting zoo and 100+ acre drive through animal adventure park, so you'll want to come back time and time again.
>
> \**Feed the animals:**
>
> Want to feed some of Franklin Drive Thru Safari's animals?
>
> Grab some feed and you can offer a snack to zebras, camels – or any of the other amazing exotic animals inside the safari – directly from your car!
>
> Want to hand feed giraffes or monkeys and lemurs as you walk around? There's also special treats you can offer them.
>
> (An additional fee for feed to be paid on-site.)
>
> \**Exotic Aviary:**
>
> Enjoy the beauty and sounds of these exotic birds from all over the world.
>
> There's all kinds of different birds, including flamingos, macaws, and toucans.

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €20.31. It was rated 4.8 out of 5 from 44 ratings and 17 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.
